_comment: The git server: how it listens and who may sign up. The Gitea page edits this; repositories and accounts are managed in Gitea's own UI. A separate gitea/secrets.json appears beside this file on first apply — machine-generated, gitignored, and safe to lose (a rebuild generates new ones and only sessions and tokens are invalidated).
_comment_root_url: Base URL written into clone addresses and links. Empty derives http://<primary LAN address>:<port>/ — set it only when the box has a better name, such as an overlay address.
_comment_registration: Whether the sign-up form works. Keep false on a personal box: the administrator creates accounts.
